_doc: File census of this repository (ground truth: git ls-files + npm pack --dry-run). Matching rule: keys are repo-root-relative paths; one optional trailing slash is stripped (dir/ == dir). A path inherits the MOST SPECIFIC entry covering it — exact match > deeper prefix > shallower prefix; a key K covers path P iff P === K or P starts with K + '/'. Labels: git = tracked in this repo, npm = shipped in the npm tarball. git:false entries document gitignore-covered machine-local zones (validated alive only where they exist on disk: this machine or any clone after gos runtime use). Reconciled from four sources by test/pack-check.sh: npm pack manifest <-> npm:true, git ls-files top-level <-> git:true, .gitignore <-> git:false, git status --porcelain -uall untracked <-> git:false entries; a root-matching or dead entry is rejected. Dispositions are executed ONE at a time via scripts/census-dispose.sh (no batch mode).
